system.description: Marked with a mystic rune, this golden gauntlet seems scuffed and somewhat dented from hard use. Since gold is a soft metal, it seems likely that the gauntlet is gold-plated steel, but none of the scuffs or dents betray any underlayer of base metal. Encumbrance: 2 When worn over the wrist of a missing hand, the Golden Hand magically seals itself in place and acts in all respects as a replacement hand. The Golden Hand has a poor sense of touch, and adds -1 to any actions requiring fine dexterity, but otherwise functions as a perfect replacement.
